raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Prepare AReaL v2.1.1 from the current `main` branch. This version includes all changes merged since v2.1.0. Update the package version in both project variants and lockfiles, and update installation and SkyPilot image examples to the corresponding v2.1.1 tags. Correct the manual release-image workflow example to use the release tag itself.

This PR prepares the version metadata; it does not create a Git tag, GitHub Release, or container images.

## Related Issue

Release preparation; no issue linked.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

Release chore with documentation updates.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files` in GitHub Actions)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality (no new functionality)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):** N/A

## Additional Context

Validation: GitHub Actions pre-commit and all package-installation checks passed. Local hooks passed on all ten changed files, and the lockfile hook was reproduced with Linux and uv 0.9.18. `git diff --check` passed, and `uv --no-config build --wheel --offline` produced `areal-2.1.1-py3-none-any.whl`. Local `pre-commit run --all-files` was attempted but stalled in the large-file check; that check passed for all changed files. Documentation build and GPU/integration tests were not run for this metadata-only change.
